en: A sepia-toned vintage street scene showing a busy urban boulevard lined with multi-story buildings featuring European architectural influences. The street is filled with pedestrians in early 20th-century attire, street vendors, and a few carts. Visible shop signs include 'Central Stationery Societe Anonyme' and 'Droubi F.A. & Co.' The caption at the bottom of the postcard reads 'Alexandria - Boulevard Saad Zagloul.'
